subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded prompt-lock session takeover aborts visible WebChat turns after tool failure instead of retrying

question: What recovery contract should OpenClaw use when an embedded turn ends with terminal `toolUse` after potentially side-effecting tools have already committed results?
rationale: Automatic whole-attempt replay risks duplicated side effects, while unconditional fail-closed behavior abandons a visible user turn; source inspection cannot choose the permanent at-most-once versus recovery semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue From Committed State
options.body: Resume with a continuation prompt from the authoritative transcript and recorded tool results, never replaying completed side-effecting calls; retry the whole attempt only when replay metadata is safe.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Retain the current manual-verification error for replay-unsafe turns and improve the in-product recovery guidance without automatic continuation.

options.title: Retry All Takeovers
options.body: Boundedly rerun every takeover or incomplete-tool turn and accept the possibility of duplicated external side effects.

recommendation.title: Continue From Committed State
recommendation.body: Resume with a continuation prompt from the authoritative transcript and recorded tool results, never replaying completed side-effecting calls; retry the whole attempt only when replay metadata is safe.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent prompt-fence work documents and tests the same transcript ownership boundary that constrains safe recovery.
